display_long_description:
Bloody Dice is a 1v1 VR dice duel where every roll can change the outcome.

At the start of each round, both players roll one hidden die. From there, you take turns choosing whether to roll again or stop. Every later roll is visible to both players, but your hidden die keeps your true score uncertain until the end.

The goal is simple: get as close to 25 as possible without going over. But every choice comes with pressure. Roll again, and you might bust. Stop too early, and your opponent may take the lead.

When both players stop, the hidden dice are revealed and the final scores are compared. Lose a round, and you may face a punishment roll, adding long-term tension across the match.

Built for virtual reality, Bloody Dice turns a simple dice game into a tense face-to-face showdown. Grab the dice, read your opponent, and decide when to take the risk.

Will you stop in time, or roll once more?
